title: Social Preview Drift Guard
description: Check public URLs for broken or inconsistent social-preview metadata across crawler-style consumers. Start with a single URL, or audit up to 100 URLs in one run.

url.title: Single URL
url.description: Public HTTP(S) URL to inspect. Use this for the quickest one-URL check.

urls.title: URLs
urls.description: Additional public HTTP(S) URLs to inspect. Maximum 100 per run.

profiles.title: Crawler profiles
profiles.description: Fetch each URL using these crawler user-agent profiles and compare the metadata each profile receives.
profiles.sectionDescription: The defaults are designed for normal link-preview QA. Change these only when you need different crawler coverage or execution limits.

checkImages.title: Probe preview images
checkImages.description: Verify that discovered preview-image URLs respond successfully with an image content type.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of URLs processed in parallel.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time allowed for each request before it is treated as a timeout.

maxHtmlMb.title: Maximum HTML response size (MB)
maxHtmlMb.description: Maximum HTML response size read per crawler profile.
